::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 29th [1871?]  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Katherine Wykes-Sneyd
:::

My dear [Pixie](people/person_539.qmd)

[Goosedom](organizations/other_104.qmd) will be very glad of Miss [Agnes Acland](people/person_45.qmd).[^1]  I believe I first missed seeing her at Oxford but I have often heard of her.  I enclose a sheet of rules, and will tell [Double Daisy](people/person_1161.qmd) to send her the questions. 

your faithful
Mother Goose

Tell Miss Acland to choose her Gosling name

---

[^1]: Agnes Henrietta Acland (b.1851)  who seems to have become a Gosling as Acorn, was the daughter of Sir Thomas Dyke Acland (1809–1898), 11th Bt., a prominent Tractarian layman with a special interest in education.
